{{Top|leg}}
'''Jayeena''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and veteran of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. In the time following that battle, Jayeena often competed in [[Flight simulator/Legends|Holosimulator]] combat scenarios against a less experienced pilot from the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]], [[Zed (pilot)|Zed]]. The pair also created their own combat simulator scenarios. One of their competitions resulted in the "Zed vs. Jayeena" holosimulator skirmish template.

==Behind the scenes==
The brief description of Jayeena does not specify if she served with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] or the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the Battle of Endor.
